# Lake Forest College

> Lake Forest College provides comprehensive academic support, student resources, and institutional information for a residential liberal arts community near Chicago.

Lake Forest College is a residential liberal arts institution located near Lake Michigan with strong commitments to student wellness, academic support through writing and science tutoring centers, and humanities education. The college offers extensive on-campus living options and counseling services to support student success.

## Key Topics

- Writing Center
- Counseling Services
- Student Housing
- Academic Calendar
- Health and Wellness

- Chicago

## About Lake Forest College

- [Mission and Values](http://www.lakeforest.edu/about-us/mission-and-values): Lake Forest College mission statement and institutional values
- [Our Campus](http://www.lakeforest.edu/about-us/our-campus): Campus overview, facilities, and location near Lake Michigan
- [About the Grant](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academics/humanities-2020-mellon-foundation-grant/about-the-grant): $1.1M Mellon Foundation grant supporting humanities education on racism

## Academic Resources & Support

- [Academic Calendar 2024 - 2025](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academic-resources/academic-calendar/academic-calendar-2024-2025): Key dates for fall/spring semesters, registration, and final exams
- [Academic Honesty](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academic-resources/writing-center/avoiding-unintentional-plagiarism/academic-honesty): Citation guidelines and plagiarism prevention using MLA and APA standards
- [Courses Supported](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academic-resources/science-resource-center/science-center-services/courses-supported): List of science and quantitative courses with tutoring support available
- [Meet Our Tutors - Writing Center](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academic-resources/writing-center/meet-our-tutors): Directory of Writing Center tutors and their specializations
- [Become a Tutor](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academic-resources/writing-center/become-a-tutor): Application and qualifications for Writing Center peer tutoring positions

## Student Health & Wellness

- [Making an Appointment](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/health-and-wellness/counseling-services/making-an-appointment): Guide to scheduling counseling appointments via Student Health Portal
- [The Resiliency Project](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/health-and-wellness/the-resiliency-project): Student wellness program for building resilience and managing failure
- [Dining](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/dining): Campus dining services, meal plans, and nutrition information

## Residence Life & Housing

- [Residency Requirement and Housing Application](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/residence-life/residency-requirement-and-housing-application): On-campus housing application process and residency requirements via StarRez
- [Roberts Hall](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/residence-life/residence-halls-and-rooms/roberts): Information on Roberts Hall residence with amenities and location details
- [Room Items for Sale or Rent](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/residence-life/room-items-for-sale-or-rent): Rental options for dorm essentials including fridges, linens, and rugs

## Accessibility & Accommodations

- [Parking Permit Accommodations](http://www.lakeforest.edu/student-resources/accessibility-services/applying-for-accommodations/parking-permit-accommodations): Disability accommodations process for parking permits via Accessibility Services

## Student Stories & Projects

- [Chisomo Mwale '19](http://www.lakeforest.edu/chisomo-mwale-19): Alumni profile of international neuroscience graduate at Northwestern
- [Heartland Alliance Oral History Project Website launched Summer 2020](http://www.lakeforest.edu/academics/humanities-2020-mellon-foundation-grant/heartland-alliance-oral-history-project): Digital archive of oral history interviews with Heartland Alliance staff
